features.name: Video intake
features.description: Accept exactly one local game video file as the runtime input.

features.name: Video metadata extraction
features.description: Read duration, mime type, file size, and preview metadata.

features.name: Frame signal extraction
features.description: Sample visual/motion signal windows from the video timeline.

features.name: Audio signal extraction
features.description: Detect audio peak and intensity windows that may indicate exciting moments.

features.name: Language/subtitle signal extraction
features.description: Use speech, subtitle, or keyword signal when available without requiring manual event records.

features.name: Highlight candidate generation
features.description: Fuse frame, audio, language, and short-window event density into candidate windows.

features.name: Multi-criteria scoring
features.description: Rank candidates by motion, audio, language keywords, continuity, and user sensitivity settings.

features.name: Clip export
features.description: Export separate MP4 highlight clips or a cut manifest that can be rendered losslessly from the source video.

features.name: Settings UI
features.description: Let the user tune minimum clip duration and sensitivity without requiring technical setup.
